issues.issue: Whether section 18.1 of the CSIS Act lets a Federal Court designated judge authorize non-identifying summaries of human-source-privileged information in civil proceedings
issues.applicant_position: AGC: section 18.1 has no express summary power, unlike s. 38 CEA or IRPA provisions, so the Designated Judge erred in finding one.
issues.respondent_position: Amici: non-identifying summaries that do not reveal or allow inference of the source's identity fall outside the privilege and are permitted.
issues.result_quote: I would declare that section 18.1 of the CSIS Act does not allow the issuance of summaries, including non-identifying ones
